The '''Sign Of The Vessel''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that can be purchased in unlimited quantity for {{Price|350}} each from [[Krobus]]' shop.  It may be placed anywhere, indoors or out.

One can be found inside [[Pam]]'s house, once [[Carpenter's Shop#Community Upgrades|upgraded]]. During her [[Pam#Nine Hearts|9 heart event]], she reveals that she bought the statue from joja.com. It can be taken by using the [[Axes|axe]] or [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]].

Placing a Sign Of The Vessel on a [[Fish Pond]] will turn it into a counter of how many [[fish]] are inside, with an image of the fish visible on the sign, and the number of fish in the pond in the lower right corner.
